title: Light Upon Light’s Enlighten Program in Edmonds School District
excerpt: Enlighten is Light Upon Light’s in-school program helping students understand differently-abled people through empathy, respectful language, and hands-on learning in Washington schools.
body:
Enlighten is one of Light Upon Light’s flagship programs.

Light Upon Light is a Washington-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 99-2690459) dedicated to advocacy, accessibility, education, and equality for differently-abled people.

Through Enlighten, we bring disability awareness into classrooms so students learn:

• Who differently-abled people are
• Why some people are differently-abled
• Respectful language
• Empathy, kindness, and inclusion

Light Upon Light has worked with partners including schools in the Edmonds School District to bring this learning directly into classrooms.

When people search for Light Upon Light and education in Washington, Enlighten is a core part of who we are.

Learn more about our programs at https://thelightuponlight.org/programs/enlighten
